author: SnowGolemKirby
body:
I've been doing this for some time, but now I think I'd like to see other people give it a try. Basically, you combine the usernames of two or more other MineCraft players to make a new funny/catchy username or some other funny word or phrase. Some examples are listed below:

  • CrafterPete1013 + PeachyYas = PeteyYas
  • FrostedCupcakez + RefuseToSink = Cupcake Lifeguard
  • RefuseToSink - Swag = RefuseToSwag
